text:
alex_k: heads up — deploybot just flagged an oscillation on canary p95 (embed route). deploybot: metric spike detected: p95 latency 780ms (5m window). auto-rollback suppressed due to active change window. need human decision.

maya_ops: can you paste the recent trend? quick graph or numbers plz. is error rate changing or just latency?

sam_eng: quick dump: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/embeds/123?panel=4 — trend shows short-lived spikes over last 12m, CPU on node pool bouncing 60-95%. error rate stable at 0.2% (no clear spike).

deploybot: thresholds: auto-rollback criteria = p95 > 800ms for 5m OR errors > 1% for 3m. current: p95 below threshold, errors below threshold. suggestion: monitor for 10m, consider manual rollback if p95 crosses 820ms or sustained CPU > 90%.

alex_k: thanks. my read: noisy but not past auto threshold. however this is the embeddings-heavy route we rolled 30m ago — we should be conservative. recommendation: pin canary to previous revision if another bump occurs within the hour.

maya_ops: agree. what does pinning look like operationally? i can coordinate the rollback if we decide. need approval from @tess_pm for customer comms?

meyers? (typo) -- not used.

sam_eng: ops steps: 1) roll canary back to v2.9.1 (last stable) 2) hold full rollout, run 15m smoke 3) if ok, resume. command: `redwoodctl rollout revert --service embeds --to v2.9.1 --scope canary` — that will not affect dedicated pools.

tess_pm: if we do a manual rollback we should prep a 1-line customer blurb: "We briefly reverted a canary release to ensure stable latency for embeddings. No action required." Ops should wait til rollback completes before announcing. :thumbsup:

alex_k: propose: watch 10 more minutes, if p95 > 820ms OR CPU > 92% on >50% of canary pods then execute revert. @maya_ops you have the go/no-go?

maya_ops: copying decision: i have control, will execute revert if threshold crosses. starting 10m watch now. initiating bridge in 5 if it worsens.

deploybot: note: because change window is active, auto-rollback remains disabled. manual rollback will bypass suppression but will create a release note event.

sam_eng: one more: after revert, let's pin the service in deploy config to v2.9.1 for 30m to avoid auto-resume. command: `redwoodctl rollout pin --service embeds --version v2.9.1 --duration 30m`

alex_k: sounds good. also flagging docs team to update the release_notes draft with the revert blurb. @tess_pm pls sign off on wording before we push public note.

tess_pm: ack. i'll be on the bridge and will approve wording.

maya_ops: (later) watching — p95 ticked to 835ms at 1716789220, CPU 94% on 60% pods. executing revert now. running command...

maya_ops: done — revert completed at 1716789265, canary back to v2.9.1. running smoke checks.

sam_eng: smoke: latency back to ~140ms p95, errors 0.15%. good.

tess_pm: approved blurb: "We reverted a canary embed release to maintain stable latency. No user action required. We're investigating the root cause and will follow up." queues: #release-notes draft updated.

alex_k: thanks team. putting a 30m pin per sam's command to avoid accidental resume. please monitor for any followups; i'll open a follow-up incident ticket for RCA. :white_check_mark:
